'''Paul Schmidt''' (born 1966)<ref name="bundestag"/> is a German politician. He currently serves as a member of the [[Bundestag]] for [[Baden-Württemberg]], as a member of [[Alternative for Germany]].<ref name=":0">{{Cite web |date=2020-11-23 |title=Der Ruderer Paul Schmidt will Steuermann werden |url=https://bnn.de/karlsruhe/karlsruhe-stadt/der-ruderer-paul-schmidt-will-steuermann-werden |access-date=2025-04-20 |website=Badische Neueste Nachrichten |language=de}}</ref><ref name="election">{{cite web |title=Elected candidates |url=https://www.bundeswahlleiterin.de/en/bundestagswahlen/2025/gewaehlte/bund-99/land-8.html#25eb6cb3-87c5-4298-8807-8cec567d8fc8 |publisher=[[Federal Returning Officer]]}}</ref>

==Early life==
{{BLP sources section|date=April 2026}}
Schmidt studied physics at the Technical University of Darmstadt, including two semesters at [[Syracuse University|Syracuse University (SU)]], Syracuse, NY, USA, where he received a rowing scholarship.{{cn|date=April 2026}} During his studies, he worked as a radiation worker in the laboratory.{{cn|date=April 2026}} In 1988, he received his Bachelor-of-Science and in 1991 his Master-of-Science degree in Physics, both at Syracuse University.{{cn|date=April 2026}}  His first professional station was the former Karlsruhe Nuclear Research Center (now [[Karlsruhe Institute of Technology|Forschungszentrum Karlsruhe)]].{{cn|date=April 2026}}

In 1993, he accepted a doctoral position at the Justus Liebig University in Giessen, Hesse, Germany, at the chair of the biophysicist Prof. Dr. Jürgen Kiefer.{{cn|date=April 2026}} He returned to Forschungszentrum Karlsruhe as a post-doc.{{cn|date=April 2026}} At the Institute for Reactor Safety, he worked on the thermohydraulic design of a lead-cooled nuclear reactor. Then came the step into industry: As project coordinator at the Gesellschaft für Nuklear Service (GNS) in Essen, Schmidt was responsible for the development of fuel-assembly  containers for energy suppliers in the USA and Italy.<ref name="bundestag">{{Cite web |title=Deutscher Bundestag - Dr. Paul Schmidt |url=https://www.bundestag.de/abgeordnete/biografien/S/schmidt_paul-1047158 |access-date=2025-04-17 |website=Deutscher Bundestag |language=de}}</ref>

In 2001, he began working at [[EnBW]] Kraftwerke AG in the department of "Fundamental Nuclear Issues" in Stuttgart and at the Philippsburg nuclear power plant ([[Philippsburg Nuclear Power Plant|KKP]]).{{cn|date=April 2026}}

==Politics==
Schmidt has cited the support of the AfD for [[nuclear power]] as his reason for joining the party in 2013.<ref name=":0"/> In 2014, he was elected city councillor in [[Karlsruhe]], later re-elected twice,<ref>{{Cite web |title=Personen - Gremieninfosystem |url=https://region-karlsruhe.gremieninfomanagement.net/personen/?__=UGhVM0hpd2NXNFdFcExjZSZ5vym4qmhcBBRmCr6BU1s |access-date=2025-04-20 |website=region-karlsruhe.gremieninfomanagement.net}}</ref> and a regional councillor in the Middle Upper Rhine Regional Association.{{cn|date=April 2026}} Since 2019 he has been the parliamentary-group chairman in both bodies.{{cn|date=April 2026}}

In 2016 and 2021,<ref>{{Cite web |last=swr.de |title=Kandidat Dr. Paul Schmidt, AfD |url=https://kandidatencheck.swr.de/landtagswahl-2021-bw/kandidat/schmidt_paul/ |access-date=2025-04-20 |website=kandidatencheck.swr.de |language=de}}</ref> Schmidt ran in the Karlsruhe I state parliament constituency, and in 2020 in the mayoral election in Karlsruhe.<ref name=":0"/><ref>{{Cite web |date=2020-11-05 |title=OB-Kandidat Paul Schmidt offiziell vorgestellt: "Karlsruhe soll sicherer und sauber werden" {{!}} ka-news |url=https://www.ka-news.de/region/karlsruhe/ob-kandidat-paul-schmidt-offiziell-vorgestellt-karlsruhe-soll-sicherer-und-sauber-werden-art-2591617 |access-date=2025-04-17 |website=ka-news.de |language=de}}</ref> He ran in the [[2025 German federal election]] on the AfD state list of Baden-Württemberg in 19th place, and was the final candidate elected from that list.<ref name="election"/>

In September 2025, the AfD established a parliamentary working group on nuclear power on Schmidt's initiative, which he currently chairs.{{cn|date=April 2026}} Schmidt is also a member of the Bundestag committee on the Environment, Climate Protection, Nature Conservation and Nuclear Safety.<ref name="bundestag"/>
